\section{Falsifiable predictions and edge cases}
\label{sec:predictions}

These predictions are normative tests for a future authorized conformance
program.  Listing them is not evidence that they have been executed or passed.

\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.22\textwidth}
                        >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.68\textwidth}@{}}
\caption{Stable SCI-JINC predictions.}\label{tab:predictions}\\
\toprule

\toprule

\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-001} & A constant finite input $z_i=z_0$ returns
$m_p=z_0$ on every accepted local support, including a cropped edge pixel. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-002} & One admitted contributor with nonzero finite
$\kappa_{ip}$ returns $m_p=z_i$, whether the coefficient is positive or
negative. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-003} & A hand-computed two-contributor case with unequal
$z_i$, $\omega_i$, and signed $\kappa_{ip}$ matches the separate $N_p$, $C_p$,
$Q_p$, $m_p$, and $T_p^{(\kappa^2)}$ equations. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-004} & Multiplying every $\omega_i$ by the same positive
factor scales $N_p$, $C_p$, and $Q_p$ together and leaves $m_p$, $\rho_p$, and
$A_{pi}$ unchanged. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-005} & Under a true inverse-variance family, rescaling
$z_i\mapsto\lambda z_i$ and $\omega_i\mapsto\omega_i/\lambda^2$ produces
$m_p\mapsto\lambda m_p$ and conditional formal weight
$W_{\mathrm{formal},p}\mapsto W_{\mathrm{formal},p}/\lambda^2$. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-006} & The analytic evaluator returns
$\kappa_a(0)=1$ through the removable limit, not a non-finite value or an
implementation-dependent substitute. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-007} & At
$r'_a=(r_{\max})_a$, the exact identity
$J_1(j_{1,1})=0$ makes the second JINC factor zero.  The resulting analytic
$\kappa_{ip}=0$ changes none of $N_p$, $C_p$, $Q_p$, or
$T_p^{(\kappa^2)}$ while remaining distinguishable from outside square
support; a rounded decimal is not the root oracle. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-008} & A finite negative lobe retains its sign in $N_p$
and $C_p$, enters $Q_p$ and $T_p^{(\kappa^2)}$ quadratically, and is not
clipped, absolutized, omitted, or flagged solely for being negative. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-009} & Exact cancellation $C_p=0$ yields local invalid
support and no finite substitute, even when $N_p$ and $Q_p$ are finite. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-010} & A finite negative $C_p$ with otherwise adequate
support yields the signed normalized estimate and is not rejected merely for
the denominator sign. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-011} & A near-cancellation construction is numerically
eligible only when a certificate $\mathcal{E}_p$ passes the exact inequality
and complete domain rules of the bound owner-approved
$\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{NA}}$; $\rho_p$ alone neither promotes nor rejects it. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-012} & With no exact owner-approved
$\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{NA}}$ and matching $\mathcal{E}_p$, numerical adequacy is
typed unavailable, even when algebraic support holds and finite arithmetic
happens to return a nonzero $C_p$. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-013} & A non-finite required signal, geometry,
coefficient evaluation, accumulator, or sample frequency cannot be masked by
multiplication by zero or silently skipped; the exact local or whole-bundle
failure rule applies. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-014} & Square-cache corners whose radius exceeds
$(r_{\max})_a$ are evaluated by Equation~\eqref{eq:analytic-kernel} and may
contribute. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-015} & Two points on opposite sides of a hypothetical
circular $r_{\max}$ boundary but inside the same resolved square are both
governed by square membership; no radial cutoff appears. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-016} & Effective \texttt{subpixel\_n}$=1$ selects bin
$q=0$ and midpoint representative $\widehat\phi=0$ on each axis for every
residual phase; it selects one point-phase matrix and does not become a
pixel-area average. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-017} & Coordinates immediately around every half-pixel
tie and phase-bin edge select the exact centers, half-open bins, indices, and
midpoint representatives of Equations~\eqref{eq:rounded-center}--
\eqref{eq:phase-representative}.  For even $n_{\mathrm{sub}}$, exact
$\phi=0$ selects the positive representative $+1/(2n_{\mathrm{sub}})$ in the
bound WCS axis orientation; no parity restriction or alternate tie rule is
permitted. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-018} & The exact rounded center immediately outside each map
edge or corner changes none of the four accumulators for any pixel, even when
its square footprint overlaps the map. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-019} & A rounded center immediately inside an edge uses
only retained square pixels with no wrap, reflection, completion,
renormalization, or edge correction. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-020} & A supported constant field at an in-map cropped
edge still returns the constant through the actual retained $N_p/C_p$ terms. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-021} & $T_p^{(\kappa^2)}$ is unchanged by changing
$\omega_i$ alone, receives zero from an analytic zero, and receives a positive
term from either sign of nonzero $\kappa_{ip}$. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-022} & Missing coefficient selection by the accepted
request or one exact owner-authorized versioned mode policy, an unregistered
family, missing JINC permission, or an unavailable/mismatched payload prevents
the affected numerical bundle without an ambient, unity, or alternate-family
fallback. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-023} & Absence of an authorized TolTEC parameter set
prevents the numerical bundle; no inherited 45~m denominator, shape values,
mode-dependent $r_{\max}$, or other implementation value is substituted. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-024} & Permuting arrays, networks, detector rows, map
groups, or container positions does not change array-to-parameter or
array-to-bundle identity; a missing array creates no placeholder and does not
invalidate another array. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-025} & Ambiguous, duplicate, or aliased destination
ownership fails the affected bundle before mutation and produces no partial
winner. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-026} & Valid decompositions of the same observation into
chunks replay the same scientific population, immutable joins, memberships,
and equations from $G_a$.  No numerical agreement claim is available without
an exact $\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{NA}}$ and matching certificates; bitwise
equality is not a scientific requirement. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-027} & An attempted cross-observation accumulator or map
combination is rejected as outside base v0.1 rather than being assigned an
inferred coadd rule. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-028} & A missing, duplicate, or ambiguous exact
signal-coordinate association under the exact PTC r0.3 and AST r0.2
boundaries prevents the affected contribution and is not reclassified as
ordinary outside support or repaired by another source identity. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-029} & Failure to form any one of the five required
whole-product roles suppresses the bundle, whereas a locally invalid pixel
does not suppress an otherwise complete role. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-030} & The base bundle contains exactly five numerical
map-plane roles and no response, covariance, formal-weight, physical-exposure,
standalone availability/support, diagnostic, generalized-provenance, or
placeholder product.  Its compact $G_a$ information state is present but is
not counted or published as a sixth product role. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-031} & With dimensionless $\omega_i$,
$Q_p/C_p^2$ remains dimensionless and is not reported as signal variance or
used to create a formal-weight product. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-032} & The JINC route consumes no SCI-MAP product and no
ordinary MAP admission, validity, exposure, support, response, covariance, or
coaddition decision is substituted for a JINC-owned decision.  A pass from
\texttt{SCI-JINC:jinc\_map\_contribution@1} means only upstream occurrence
admission for consideration. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-033} & A changed byte, identity, version, compatibility,
or supersession fact for the exact PTC r0.3 boundary, AST r0.2 boundary,
admission profile, SCI-VAL binding, source-register successor, or profile-
registry successor makes the affected route unavailable; no nearby source or
name match is accepted.  Matching SCI-VAL process bindings creates no new
scientific content, coefficient family, parameter set, or adequacy profile. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-034} & Passing
\texttt{SCI-JINC:jinc\_map\_contribution@1} leaves rounded-center admission,
sample-pixel membership, cancellation support, numerical adequacy, numerical
contribution, and bundle publication to their separate exact gates. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-035} & A target WCS whose pixel matrix is anisotropic or
skewed fails Equation~\eqref{eq:square-wcs-metric} and cannot enter base v0.1
through a scalar pixel size.  A compatible matrix preserves its exact axis
ordering, signs, rotation, and handedness in phase and cache interpretation. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-PRED-036} & Replaying the immutable references and bounded
state in $G_a$ reproduces the exact input population, PTC/AST joins, admission,
coefficient and parameter identities, target metric, center/phase/bin/cache
decisions, square/edge membership, destination, lifecycle, required-role
states, failure, and completion without a dense per-contribution archive. \\
